dedupe_keys.name: leap energy planning and emissions modelling software stockholm environment institute

description: LEAP is an energy planning and emissions modelling tool from the Stockholm Environment Institute, which holds copyright from 1982 to 2026 according to the site read on 2026-09-26. The site offers downloads, a user guide, training materials, courses and a member community, and links related SEI tools: the Impact Benefits Calculator, the LEAP Cloud Data Server and NEMO, the Next Energy Modeling system for Optimization. A news item of 19 July 2026 announces version 2026.7.0.3 with improvements to optimisation, transmission and fuel trade modelling through NEMO version 2.4, tree filtering and optional anonymised diagnostics, and says it is backwards compatible with older models. Coverage is typically national or regional energy systems across demand, supply and power sectors. Access requires a free member account; the licence page is visible only to members, so licence terms and any fees were not read. Caveats: data for a country model must be assembled by the user, and the licence terms could not be checked. Simulation uses are scenario-based capacity planning of power and fuel supply, least-cost optimisation through NEMO, and mitigation planning for climate policy. Related records: model-osemosys and model-times-etsap are other long-term energy system models used for national planning.
